name: Magikarp
description: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
